page_title: VLL 0-1 CEL | Valladolid v Celta Vigo 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' The attendance for today's match is 17521.
90+8' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+7' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

90+7' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Substitution. Jailson (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oscar Mingueza walks off.
90+4' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

90+2' Chuki (Valladolid) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
90+1' Substitution. Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid) in, Mamadou Sylla out.
90+1' Alvaro Rubio has decided to substitute Antonio Candela and he is replaced by Darwin Machis (Valladolid).
90+1' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) gets a yellow card. The referee Victor Garcia made the right call.
90+1' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo in a dangerous position.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

87' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Valladolid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
86' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Alfonso Gonzalez will be replaced by Iker Losada (Celta Vigo).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Hugo Sotelo can be given a rest.

84' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
83' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Karl Hein to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
82' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) earns the yellow card.
82' The main referee, Victor Garcia, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Raul Moro (Valladolid) is given a yellow card for dissent.
82' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
81' It’s a PENALTY to Celta Vigo after the VAR review!

81' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Celta Vigo.
80' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

80' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
78' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

78' CHANCE! Chuki finds Marcos Andre (Valladolid) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
77' Flag up against Raul Moro (Valladolid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
76' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
76' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
75' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. Valladolid have a free kick.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Martin departs the field of play to be replaced by Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
72' That's unlucky! Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
71' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) replaces Iago Aspas.
71' Borja Iglesias goes off the pitch and Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) comes on.
71' Flag goes up against Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
69' The foul by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Valladolid earn a free kick.
67' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
66' Raul Moro (Valladolid) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
65' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) will miss the next game.
65' It's like he was asking for a caution. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card.
63' Here is a change. Anuar is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
63' The substitution has been made. Chuki (Valladolid) has replaced Florian Grillitsch.
60' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
60' Mario Martin (Valladolid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Celta Vigo win a free kick.
59' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' NO PENALTY! Referee Victor Garcia has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Celta Vigo players are incensed.
56' Yellow card! It's like Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Victor Garcia agrees and books him.
55' Celebrations by Celta Vigo are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

54' Karl Hein (Valladolid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty to Celta Vigo! Let's see who's going to take it.
50' The game is interrupted now, Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

48' Valladolid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul. Valladolid are awarded a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' An accurate cross picks out Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
45+1' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

43' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
42' Raul Moro (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vicente Guaita, who smothers the ball.
41' The Valladolid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.

31' Mario Martin (Valladolid) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Vicente Guaita is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Valladolid will take a corner kick.
30' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Celta Vigo get a free kick.
27' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Celta Vigo for a penalty. Play continues.

24' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
23' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
23' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
22' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Valladolid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
21' The Valladolid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
18' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
18' The ratio of the ball possession is 32:68.
16' Mario Martin (Valladolid) rises high on the edge of the box to meet a cross and plants a powerful header goalwards, but Vicente Guaita is alert and makes a decent save to deny him.
14' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Raul Moro (Valladolid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

11' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
10' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' The corner from Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is hurriedly cleared.

6' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
2' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Valladolid will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
